The food is a patty roughly 120 px wide and 130 px tall, so about 8 cm by 8.5 cm. That is a fairly large patty, perhaps 1.5 cm thick, which works out to about 75 cm³. It looks like a breaded or grain-based patty, possibly a veggie burger or sausage patty, so I assume about 0.9 g/cm³ and get roughly 70 g.

At about 2.3 kcal/g for a breaded patty, that is around 160 kcal. Allowing for a slightly higher-energy patty, I settle on about 180 kcal.
